title.zh: 在伊洛伊洛市增设市镇审判法院分庭，为此修订1980年《司法重组法》并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An act establishing additional branches of the Municipal Trial Court in the City of Iloilo, amending for the purpose the Judiciary Reorganization Act of 1980, and appropriating funds therefor
title.orig: An act establishing additional branches of the Municipal Trial Court in the City of Iloilo, amending for the purpose the Judiciary Reorganization Act of 1980, and appropriating funds therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Tòa án additional branches of the Municipal Trial tại Thành phố Iloilo, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งศาล additional branches of the Municipal Trial ในเมือง Iloilo และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk Pengadilan additional branches of the Municipal Trial di Kota Iloilo, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Mahkamah additional branches of the Municipal Trial di Bandar Iloilo, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2004/ra_9306_2004.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Supreme Court shall promulgate the necessary rules and regulations for the effective implementation of this Act.

The Chief Justice of the Supreme Court in coordination with the Secretary of the Department of Justice shall immediately include in its program the operationalization of the additional Municipal Trial Courts in the City of Iloilo, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
